canonical_project: Telis Energie Deutschland Mehrum data center campus
notes: Campus planned near Mehrum in Hohenhameln, Landkreis Peine. NDR reported six buildings on about 380,000 sqm, at least EUR 1 billion investment, council initiation of planning, and possible 2028 construction start. DataCenter-Insider reports a planned connection load of around 500 MW for a multi-tenant colocation campus. Municipality has a public planning page for the FNP amendment and 'Rechenzentrum' development plan.
